english_text: I have been having night sweats and losing weight for two months.
sesotho_text: Ke bile le molapo oa bosiu le ho lahleheloa ke boima ka likhoeli tse peli.

english_text: I am HIV-positive and I am seven months pregnant.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke ima likhoeli tse supileng.

english_text: My baby tested positive for HIV at six weeks and I need help.
sesotho_text: Ngoana oa ka o hlahlobelitsoe HIV mme o fumane sephetho se molemo ka libeke tse tšeletseng mme ke hloka thuso.

english_text: I have HIV and my eyes have been getting blurry over the past few weeks.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme mahlo a ka a bile a fifala libeke tse fetileng tse itseng.

english_text: I have difficulty swallowing and I think it is related to my HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke na le bothata ba ho metsa mme ke nahana hore bo amana le HIV ea ka.

english_text: Differentiated service delivery models reduce the burden on health facilities.
sesotho_text: Mehlala ea fapaneng ea ho fana ka litshebeletso e fokotsa morwalo oa likamore tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Multi-month dispensing of ART reduces the number of clinic visits required.
sesotho_text: Ho abela ART ka likhoeli tse ngata ka nako e le ngoe ho fokotsa palo ea litsela tsa kliniki tse hlokahalang.

english_text: Community ART distribution points bring medicines closer to people who need them.
sesotho_text: Libaka tsa phatlalatso ea ART sechabeng li tlisa meriana haufi le batho ba e hlokang.

english_text: Fast-track ART refill services are available for stable patients at many clinics.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa ho tlatsa ART ka potlako li fumaneha bakeng sa bakuli ba tsitsitseng likhlinikhing tse ngata.

english_text: Stable HIV patients on ART can collect up to three months of medicine at a time.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba HIV ba tsitsitseng ba holim'a ART ba ka kgotha meriana ea likhoeli tse tharo ka nako e le ngoe.

english_text: Patients who miss clinic appointments should be traced and supported to return to care.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lahlehileng meeto ea kliniki ba lokela ho batlooa le ho tsheheltsoa ho khutlela tlhokomelong.

english_text: Loss to follow-up from HIV care is a major challenge in many countries.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela tlhokomelo ea HIV ke mathata a maholo linaheng tse ngata.

english_text: Electronic health records improve the tracking and management of HIV patients.
sesotho_text: Lirekhoto tsa bophelo bo botle tsa elektroniki li ntlafatsa ho latela le ho laola bakuli ba HIV.

english_text: HIV programme data should be used to improve the quality of care.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la HIV e lokela ho sebelisoa ho ntlafatsa boleng ba tlhokomelo.

english_text: Integration of HIV services with other health services improves access and efficiency.
sesotho_text: Ho kopanya litshebeletso tsa HIV le litshebeletso tse ling tsa bophelo bo botle ho ntlafatsa phihlello le bokgoni.

english_text: Broadly neutralising antibodies are being studied as a potential HIV treatment and prevention tool.
sesotho_text: Li-antibody tse phanyolang ka bophara li ithutoa e le sesebelisoa se ka khonehang sa phekolo le thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: HIV cure research aims to eliminate the virus from the body completely.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa pholo ea HIV li ikemiseditse ho felisa vaerase 'meleng ka botlalo.

english_text: The HIV reservoir consists of cells that harbour dormant HIV and are not eliminated by ART.
sesotho_text: Polokelo ea HIV e bopiloe ke lisele tse bolokang HIV e robetseng mme e sa felisoe ke ART.

english_text: Shock and kill strategies aim to activate latent HIV so it can be eliminated.
sesotho_text: Maano a shock le kill a ikemiseditse ho vuseletsa HIV e patileng hore e tle e felisoe.

english_text: Gene therapy approaches are being explored as a potential HIV cure strategy.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa ea phekolo ea gene e hlahlojoa e le leano le ka khonehang la pholo ea HIV.

english_text: An effective HIV vaccine would be the most powerful tool to end the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ente ea HIV e sebetsang e ka ba sesebelisoa se matla ka ho fetisisa sa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Several HIV vaccine candidates are currently in clinical trials.
sesotho_text: Liente tse ling tse ling tsa HIV li se li le ho lekoa lihlahlobong tsa kliniki hona joale.

english_text: Lenacapavir is a long-acting injectable HIV medicine given twice a year.
sesotho_text: Lenacapavir ke moriana oa HIV o kenngoa ka mesipi o sebetsang nako e telele o neoang habeli ka selemo.

english_text: Cabotegravir plus rilpivirine is a long-acting injectable ART regimen given every two months.
sesotho_text: Cabotegravir hammoho le rilpivirine ke leano la ART la ho kenngoa ka mesipi le sebetsang nako e telele le neoang likhoeli tse peli le tse peli.

english_text: Islatravir is a novel antiretroviral being studied as part of long-acting treatment regimens.
sesotho_text: Islatravir ke antiretroviral e ncha e ithutoa e le karolo ea mananeo a phekolo a sebetsang nako e telele.

english_text: Key populations are groups at higher risk of HIV due to specific behaviours or circumstances.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa ke lihlopha tse leng kotsing e kholo ea HIV ka lebaka la maitshwaro kapa maemo a khethehileng.

english_text: Key populations include sex workers men who have sex with men transgender people and people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa se kenyelletsa basebetsi ba thobalano banna ba robetsanang le banna batho ba fetohang bong le batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: Key populations face stigma and discrimination that prevent them from accessing HIV services.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bohlokoa se tobana le kekello le khethollo tse se thibelang ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV services for key populations must be non-judgmental and confidential.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa sechaba se bohlokoa li lokela ho se ahlole mme li boloke sephiri.

english_text: Peer-led outreach programmes are effective at reaching key populations with HIV services.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a phono a etelletsoe pele ke bahlankana a sebetsa hantle ho fihla sechaba se bohlokoa ka litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: Criminalisation of key populations increases HIV risk by driving them away from health services.
sesotho_text: Ho etsoa molato ha sechaba se bohlokoa ho eketsa kotsi ea HIV ka ho se khahlela ho tsoa litshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Sex workers have the right to access HIV prevention testing and treatment services.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba thobalano ba na le tokelo ea ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa thibelo ea HIV liteko le phekolo.

english_text: Condom distribution programmes for sex workers are an effective HIV prevention strategy.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a phatlalatso ea likhohlopo bakeng sa basebetsi ba thobalano ke leano le sebetsang la thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: Men who have sex with men are disproportionately affected by HIV in many regions.
sesotho_text: Banna ba robetsanang le banna ba angoa ke HIV ka mokgwa o sa lekanang libakeng tse ngata.

english_text: PrEP is highly recommended for men who have sex with men at high risk of HIV.
sesotho_text: PrEP e khothalletsoa haholo bakeng sa banna ba robetsanang le banna ba leng kotsing e kholo ea HIV.

english_text: Transgender women have one of the highest HIV prevalence rates of any population group.
sesotho_text: Basali ba fetohileng bong ba na le e 'ngoe ea likhato tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa tsa HIV ho lihlopha tsohle tsa sechaba.

english_text: HIV services for transgender people should be integrated with gender-affirming care.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa batho ba fetohang bong li lokela ho kopanyoa le tlhokomelo e netefatsang bong.

english_text: Needle and syringe programmes reduce HIV transmission among people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a mesipi le li-syringe a fokotsa phetisetso ea HIV ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: Opioid substitution therapy reduces HIV risk in people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea ho nka sebaka sa opioid e fokotsa kotsi ea HIV ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: People in prisons and closed settings have higher HIV prevalence than the general population.
sesotho_text: Batho ba khotsofatsong le libakeng tse koalehileng ba na le palo e phahameng ea HIV ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: HIV testing and ART must be available in all prisons and detention centres.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV le ART li lokela ho fumaneha likotsofatsong tsohle le lisentareng tsa ho tshoareloa.

english_text: Migrants and refugees may face barriers to accessing HIV services.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba fetang le baphaphathehi ba ka tobana le meqoqo ea ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV services should be accessible to all people regardless of nationality or immigration status.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV li lokela ho fumaneha ho batho bohle ntle le ho sheba bochaba kapa boemo ba ho fallela naheng.

english_text: Homeless people living with HIV face particular challenges in maintaining ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Batho ba hlokang ntlo ba phelang le HIV ba tobana le mathata a khethehileng ho boloka ho latela ART.

english_text: Integrated social support is essential for homeless people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e kopaneng ea sechaba e bohlokoa bakeng sa batho ba hlokang ntlo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Women and girls account for more than half of all people living with HIV in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Basali le banana ba bua karolo e fetang halofo ea batho bohle ba phelang le HIV Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Gender inequality and power imbalances increase women's vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho se lekane ha bong le ho se lekane ha matla ho eketsa bokoa ba basali ho HIV.

english_text: Women often have less power to negotiate condom use with their partners.
sesotho_text: Basali hangata ba na le matla a fokolang a ho buisana ka tshebediso ea likhohlopo le balekane ba bona.

english_text: Intimate partner violence is associated with increased HIV risk in women.
sesotho_text: Tlhoriso ea molekane ea haufi e amahanngoa le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV ho basali.

english_text: Women who experience violence are less likely to access HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bonang tlhoriso ba ka nna ba se fumane liteko tsa HIV le phekolo ka bonolo.

english_text: HIV programmes must address gender-based violence as part of a comprehensive response.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a HIV a lokela ho sebetsana le tlhoriso e thehiloeng holim'a bong e le karolo ea karabelo e pharalletseng.

english_text: Economic empowerment of women reduces their vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho matlafatsa basali ka moruo ho fokotsa bokoa ba bona ho HIV.

english_text: Men are less likely than women to test for HIV and access treatment.
sesotho_text: Banna ba ka nna ba se hlahlobeloe HIV le ho fumana phekolo ka bonolo ho feta basali.

english_text: Engaging men in HIV prevention and treatment is essential for ending the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa banna thibelong ea HIV le phekolo ho bohlokoa bakeng sa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Harmful gender norms that discourage men from seeking healthcare increase HIV mortality.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa ea bong e kotsi e thibelang banna ho batla tlhokomelo ea bophelo e eketsa lefu la HIV.

english_text: Access to HIV prevention testing and treatment is a fundamental human right.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlella thibelo ea HIV liteko le phekolo ke tokelo ea motheo ea botho.

english_text: HIV-related discrimination in healthcare settings is a violation of human rights.
sesotho_text: Khethollo e amanang le HIV libakeng tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ke tlolo ea litokelo tsa botho.

english_text: People living with HIV have the right to privacy and confidentiality.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea sephiri le ho bolokoa ha sephiri.

english_text: Forced HIV testing is a violation of human rights and undermines public health.
sesotho_text: Ho qobelloa ho hlahlobeloa HIV ke tlolo ea litokelo tsa botho mme ho senya bophelo bo botle ba sechaba.

english_text: People living with HIV have the right to marry and have children.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea ho nyalana le ho ba le bana.

english_text: Travel restrictions based on HIV status are discriminatory and should be abolished.
sesotho_text: Melaolelo ea ho tsamaea e thehiloeng holim'a boemo ba HIV ke khethollo mme e lokela ho fenyoa.

english_text: People living with HIV should be involved in decisions about HIV policies and programmes.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho kenyelletsooa liqetong mabapi le maano le mananeo a HIV.

english_text: The greater involvement of people living with HIV is a core principle of the HIV response.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsooa ho hoholo ha batho ba phelang le HIV ke molaotheo oa motheo oa karabelo ea HIV.

english_text: Legal protections for people living with HIV must be enforced at all levels.
sesotho_text: Tshireletso ea molao bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV e lokela ho phetha-phethoa maemong ohle.

english_text: Stigma reduction laws and policies create an enabling environment for the HIV response.
sesotho_text: Melao le maano a ho fokotsa kekello a theha tikoloho e khothaletsang karabelo ea HIV.

english_text: The prevalence of depression in people living with HIV is two to three times higher than in the general population.
sesotho_text: Palo ea ho nyamela ho batho ba phelang le HIV e phahame habeli ho isa ho makhetlo a mararo ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: Untreated depression in people living with HIV leads to poor ART adherence and worse outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho nyamela ho sa phekoluoang ho batho ba phelang le HIV ho lebisa ho ho latela ART ho fokolang le liphetho tse mpe.

english_text: Antidepressant medicines can be used safely in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea ho loa nyamela e ka sebelisoa ka polokeho ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Cognitive behavioural therapy is effective for depression and anxiety in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea maitshwaro a mahutu e sebetsa hantle bakeng sa ho nyamela le ho tšaba ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder affects thinking memory and concentration.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba neurocognitive bo amanang le HIV bo angoa ho nahana ho hopola le ho tsepamisa kelello.

english_text: ART can slow the progression of HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder.
sesotho_text: ART e ka khutsufatsa tsoelo-pele ea bolwetse ba neurocognitive bo amanang le HIV.

english_text: Screening for cognitive impairment should be part of routine HIV care.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ho fokoleng ha mahutu ho lokela ho ba karolo ea tlhokomelo ea kamehla ea HIV.

english_text: Alcohol and substance use disorders are significantly more common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mafu a tšebediso ea joala le lintho tse kotsi a atile haholo ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Integrated treatment for HIV and substance use disorders improves outcomes for both conditions.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e kopaneng ea HIV le mafu a tšebediso ea lintho tse kotsi e ntlafatsa liphetho tsa maemo a mabeli.

english_text: Mindfulness-based interventions can reduce stress and improve quality of life in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Meketso e thehiloeng holim'a ho ela hloko e ka fokotsa khatello le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Food insecurity is associated with poor ART adherence and worse HIV outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka tšepo ea lijo ho amahanngoa le ho latela ART ho fokolang le liphetho tse mpe tsa HIV.

english_text: Nutritional support programmes improve ART initiation and retention in care.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tshehetso ea phepo a ntlafatsa ho qala ART le ho lula tlhokomelong.

english_text: Ready-to-use therapeutic food is used to treat severe acute malnutrition in HIV-positive children.
sesotho_text: Lijo tsa phekolo tse loketse ho sebelisoa hang li sebelisoa ho phekola ho hloka phepo ho matla ho bana ba nang le HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV should avoid consuming unpasteurised dairy products.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho hana ho ja lihlahisoa tsa lebese tse sa phethisoang.
